purpose: Track global public, philanthropic, research and open-source funding pathways that can sustainably support the encyclopedia and other public-benefit work without making paid services part of the core runtime or surrendering project independence.

fundingPrinciples.coreIdea: Accept compatible external support without making payment a condition for access or making a funder the owner of the project.

opportunities.name: NSF PESOSE
opportunities.region: United States / international collaboration possible subject to NSF eligibility
opportunities.amount: Track 1 up to USD 300,000; Tracks 2-3 up to USD 1,500,000
opportunities.fit: High for open-source AI, data platforms, secure/sustainable ecosystems, governance and security infrastructure.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: Formal NSF solicitation and submitting-organization eligibility must be checked; not an automatic individual grant.

opportunities.name: NLnet Foundation - Open Internet Stack / successor calls
opportunities.amount: Typically EUR 5,000-50,000, with scaling possible where justified
opportunities.fit: High for open software, open data, standards, resilient infrastructure and public-interest digital commons.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: NLnet says calls reopen on 2026-09-03 and requires libre/open outputs; exact fund eligibility must be checked when the call opens.

opportunities.name: NLnet Restack
opportunities.region: Global / independent researchers subject to call eligibility
opportunities.amount: EUR 7 million programme budget across calls
opportunities.fit: High for independent open research that strengthens the Open Internet Stack and digital commons.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: Call-specific eligibility, scope and deadlines govern each application.

opportunities.name: Sovereign Tech Fund
opportunities.region: Global investment reach; applicant and project criteria apply
opportunities.amount: Project cost must exceed EUR 50,000 under current requirements
opportunities.fit: Medium to high only if the work is genuinely open digital base technology, security or infrastructure rather than primarily a user-facing application.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: The fund explicitly does not finance prototypes and prioritizes open digital base technologies; suitability for the encyclopedia must be established before applying.

opportunities.name: Google Research Awards - Education / AI / Trust, Safety, Security & Privacy
opportunities.region: Global through eligible universities and research institutions
opportunities.amount: Up to USD 100,000 for listed research calls; exceptional larger awards may be considered in some calls
opportunities.fit: High for Arabic NLP/OCR/ASR, responsible AI, privacy/security and education research when hosted by an eligible academic institution.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: Professor/PI eligibility and topic-specific deadlines apply; funds are issued to universities or degree-granting institutions.

opportunities.name: Meta Llama Impact Grants / Impact Innovation Awards
opportunities.region: Global; some programmes target Africa, Middle East, Turkey, Asia Pacific and Latin America
opportunities.fit: Medium to high for open-source AI with measurable social impact, including education and underserved-language access.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: Current opportunity windows, eligible applicant types and technology-specific terms must be verified for each call; inclusion in this registry is not an endorsement of any model license.

opportunities.name: EU Horizon Europe / Open Internet Stack related funding
opportunities.amount: Call specific; 2026 Digital, Industry and Space calls included more than EUR 307 million across topics, including an Open Internet Stack initiative
opportunities.fit: High for open infrastructure, trustworthy AI, data services, strategic autonomy and digital commons in suitable consortia.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: Horizon Europe eligibility and consortium rules are strict; the encyclopedia would normally need an eligible institutional/consortium route.

opportunities.name: Arabic Book / Digital Humanities research ecosystem precedents
opportunities.fit: Very high thematic fit for Arabic OCR, HTR, NLP, Arabic book history and digital humanities.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: KITAB-Transform demonstrates current ERC-funded research around the Arabic book, Islamicate studies, digital humanities and text reuse; treat this as a partnership/funding-model precedent, not an open call.

opportunities.name: COST Digital Humanities STSMs
opportunities.fit: High as a model for computational humanities datasets, corpora and computer-vision experiments; monitor future calls.
opportunities.eligibilityNote: The 2026 listed call is closed; retain as a future-network reference only.

tier2_upcoming: NLnet Open Internet Stack successor calls
tier3_institutional: NSF PESOSE through eligible institutional partners
doNotDo: make paid APIs a core dependency because a grant is available
adopt a restricted model only because funding pays for it
claim eligibility without checking the current call
double-fund the same proposed activity across public grants
promise ownership rights that the signed funding agreement does not provide

submissionRules: Verify the live call, deadline, geography and applicant eligibility before submission.
Separate grant-funded research outputs from runtime production dependencies.
Keep all license, provenance, model, dataset and voice gates unchanged.
Publish research outputs under compatible open terms whenever the fund requires openness.
Record any funded activity and avoid claiming the same cost or work twice.
Funding status never promotes an Engine Evolution candidate to adopted.
Do not promise that funding preserves ownership until the funding agreement has been reviewed.
Any optional donations or sponsorships are secondary support, never a condition of access to the encyclopedia.
